title: Culture & Colour Trail
summary: Temples, ancient cities and culture around every corner.
inclusions: Private vehicle with driver (subject to quotation)

itinerary.title: Day 1: Colombo to Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Begin your Sri Lankan heritage journey in Colombo before travelling towards Sigiriya. Enjoy the scenic countryside and, subject to your schedule, explore local cultural attractions.

itinerary.title: Day 2: Discover Sigiriya
itinerary.description: Explore the Sigiriya area, famous for its ancient rock fortress, archaeological heritage and traditional village experiences. Entrance tickets and guided activities are subject to confirmation.

itinerary.title: Day 3: Sigiriya to Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel towards Kandy with optional cultural and heritage stops along the way. Discover Kandy's historic atmosphere and visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic if included in your confirmed itinerary.

itinerary.title: Day 4: Explore Kandy
itinerary.description: Enjoy a final day exploring Kandy's cultural landmarks and local surroundings before your onward journey or return transfer, as agreed in your quotation.
